sentences.text:
Ganesh & Anr. vs The State Of M.P. on 14 December, 2023
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vinay Saraf
 On The 14 th Of December, 2023
 Criminal Appeal No. 1169 of 2005

BETWEEN:-
 1. GANESH & ANR. (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. THAGI BAI W/O HEERU, AGED ABOUT 48 YEARS,
 VILL KHAMLA PS BHESDEHI DIST BETUL MP  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ANAND SHUKLA-AMICUS CURIAE)
 AND  THE STATE OF M.P. (MADHYA PRADESH)
 ..
 (BY SHRI PRASANNAJIT CHATERJI-PANEL LAWYER )

This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e cour  following:
 ORDER

The present appeal has been preferred by the appellants under Section 374(2) of the Cr.P.C. being aggrieved by the judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the First Additional Sessions Judge,
Betul in Sessions Trial No.27/2005 dated 26.5.2005 whereby the learned Sessions Judge has convicted the appellants for the offences punishable under Section 498-A of the IPC and sentenced them to undergo RI for one year and six months with fine of Rs.200/- each and in default to undergo further simple imprisonment of one month.

2. After perusal of the record of the sessions court, it appears that in the intervening night of 6.8.2004 and 7.8.2004, the appellant and other co-accused harassed the deceased and committed cruelty as well as abated for commission of suicide and in furtherance of the same, deceased Devkabai committed suicide by jumping in well with her son Alkesh.

The Sub Inspector-Ajay Mishra lodged the FIR on the basis of enquiry against the appellants Shankar and Bedibai for the offences punishable under Section 498A and 306 of the IPC and after investigation, the charge-sheet was filed.

3. During trial PW2-Namdeo, the father of the deceased, PW2-Sitabai the mother of the deceased supported the allegation levied by the prosecution and stated in the court that marriage of Devkabai was solemnized with appellant- Ganesh and appellant-Thangibai was mother-in-law of the Ganesh & Anr. vs The State Of M.P. on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42178495/
1 deceased.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was stated by them that Devkabai used to complained time to time to them that accused persons used to commit cruelty in furtherance of the demand of money and therefore, she committed suicide.
In respect of the incident, PW1-Raghu and PW 4-Duggibai, PW5-Kadma and PW6-Ratanlal and PW7-Limbaji stated that body of Devkabai and her son was found in the well.

P.W.8-Dr. Manish Sharma opined that death was due to asphyxia and on account of drowning and the duration was 36 to 48 hours.
4. Learned Session Court after considering the evidence of the witnesses acquitted all the accused persons from the charges of 306 of the IPC and acquitted the Shankar and Bedibai from the charges of 498A of the IPC but found the charges proved against the appellants Ganesh and Thagibai under Section 498A of the IPC and sentenced them accordingly.
5.

After considering the statements of the witnesses, it appears that learned Sessions Court has properly appreciated the evidence and no illegality or irregularity was committed in convicting the appellants under Section 498A of the IPC.

However, in the facts and circumstances of the present case and considering the fact that the offence occurred in the year 2004 and the age of the appellant Ganesh was just 25 year at that time whereas the appellant Thagi Bai was of 55 year and after 19 years she must be around 75 years and the appellant Ganesh remained in custody from 10.10.2004 to 26.5.2005 whereas the appellant Thagi bai remained in custody from 10.10.2004 to 7.2.2005 and also that under Section 498A no minimum sentence is prescribed, I deem it proper to reduce the sentence to the period which the appellants have already undergone and accordingly, the sentence is reduced.
6. Accordingly, the appeal is partly allowed.

(VINAY SARAF) JUDGE P/-
